description: Land Acquisition - Magurugoda, Elapatha D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Weraniyagoda, Elapatha D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Amend to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2272/52 of 25.03.2022
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land locations, extents, lot numbers, boundaries, and claimants. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land acquisitions" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification. There is no government personnel or structural changes, legal/regulatory framework establishment, commercial matters, or other specialized categories present.
